# Anne Shirley & Davy Keith

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — relies on her kindness to save food for him · since v2  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P55](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0055), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P34](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0034), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Mentor of — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — pupil in her school class · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) arrives home with the orphaned Keith twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose contrasting behaviors quickly manifest during dinner and bedtime. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) creates chaos throughout his first week, first by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church and later by tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling into a pigpen before attempting to pump water on her. After being sent to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also placed a toad in Marilla's bed, which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) frantically removes.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed out of mischief. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hastily retrieves the toad with a fire shovel and releases it in the cherry orchard before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) notices, after which she spots [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signaling to her from her window.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), truthfulness, and the Village Improvement Society's hall project with Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md). Shortly after [Joshua Pye](../character/joshua-pye.md) finishes painting the hall, Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discovers it was accidentally painted bright blue instead of green due to a mix-up with the paint numbers. Although the society members are devastated, the incident earns them widespread sympathy from the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) community.
>
> — v2 · IX A Question of Color

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) enjoys a peaceful walk home along the [Birch Path](../codex/places.md#birch-path) and chats with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) before arriving at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is missing. After a frantic search and dragging the well, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted for his trickery and lying, eventually breaking down in remorse and promising to reform before being sent to bed.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) lectures [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) about telling falsehoods after he tries to test Marilla's warning about skipping prayers. Downstairs, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) shares the joke with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and they discuss the challenges of raising the twins, admitting that despite his mischief, they both prefer [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) over the perfectly behaved [Dora](../character/dora.md).
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

> In an irritable mood caused by a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has a terrible day at school, accidentally causing fireworks to explode in the classroom and later whipping [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) for putting a mouse in her desk. Returning home in despair, she confesses to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), who comforts her and reassures her that everyone makes mistakes. The next day, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) is amazed to find that whipping Anthony actually won his respect, a fact later confirmed by Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks home with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), discussing community news and Marilla's improving eyesight. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learn that the twins' uncle cannot take them until autumn, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) helps correct Davy's funny theological misunderstandings after catching him eating plum jam. Later, at an [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting, the members are appalled to learn that [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) plans to rent his fence to a patent medicine company for advertising, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane.md) fail to persuade him otherwise.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) corrects Davy's confused idea about heaven before sharing exciting news from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) that famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will be visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) agrees to let [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) handle the meal, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends the next day diligently cleaning the house and preparing the food with help from [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [John Henry Carter](../character/john-henry-carter.md).
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) excitedly prepare [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and a grand dinner for the guest of honor, Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). However, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies, the guest of honor fails to arrive, and the dinner suffers from cooking mishaps and damaged property. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later receives a letter explaining Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle, making sense of the day's disappointment.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> Following the party guests' departure, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a letter explaining that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) will not be able to visit. Sitting on the porch at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss handling the broken platter, local gossip about Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), and life's disappointments before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) converses with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals her to come over with news about a potential replacement willow-ware platter. The two girls travel along the [Tory Road](../codex/places.md#tory-road) to search for the platter at the old Copp homestead. After [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) climbs onto an old duckhouse roof to look into the pantry window and gets stuck, a rainstorm hits, but she stays amused by writing a story until Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) Copp returns and helps free her.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends a pleasant day taking the twins to the shore with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and visiting [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) for tea, reassuring him about his imaginative thoughts. When she returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she helps a jealous [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) with his bedtime prayers and reassures him of her affection. Later at twilight, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble) and notices how much [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) has grown up.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finish talking with [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) before walking down to Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where she meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) to discuss their ideals and the progress of the [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers). Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to the house and talks with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) about her plans for the upcoming day and the return to school.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) depart for town while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) stays home and prepares to transfer feathers between ticks, accidentally dying her nose red in a mishap with carpet dye. [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md), forcing [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to compose herself despite her disheveled appearance. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) helps [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) host the guests, and they all enjoy a pleasant dinner and a scenic walk before the visitors leave.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching, dealing with schoolroom incidents involving [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), and [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md). Later in October, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) get lost while walking to tea in [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#east-grafton) and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the secluded home of Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md). Miss Lavendar warmly invites them to stay for a pretend tea party she had set up to cure her loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Miss Lavendar [Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), her past relationship with [Stephen Irving](../character/stephen-irving.md), and the health of [Thomas Lynde](../character/thomas-lynde.md) while managing Davy's poor table manners. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) promises [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) dyed feathers for an Indian headdress to keep him happy. A month later, news arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died, leaving a trust fund for [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), which ensures they can stay permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables).
>
> — v2 · XXII Odds and Ends

> After a newspaper item pokes fun at Uncle Abe's weather predictions, a sudden and devastating severe hail storm hits [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) weather the storm at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, only to find extensive damage to crops, trees, and windows across the village. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) grieves the loss of his parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) later visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as the community takes stock of the destruction.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

> A surprising visitor arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and announces that she is his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md). The news quickly spreads through [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), leading to rumors and curiosity. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) visits Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md), who sheepishly admits he is glad his wife has returned before preparing to explain the full story of their past separation.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) how he and his wife [Emily](../character/emily.md) separated after arguments over housecleaning, grammar, and his swearing parrot [Ginger](../character/ginger.md), though they have now reconciled. Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) returns with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), walks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) home, and expresses her joy at being back with her husband. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hears the latest gossip from Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before putting a sleepy [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) to bed.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

> At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) chat during dinner about [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md) and general curiosities before [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) walk to [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). There, they are warmly welcomed by Miss Lavendar and Charlotta the Fourth for afternoon food and conversation. Afterward, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) plays with the echoes while [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) head off to pick wild strawberries.
>
> — v2 · XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House
